title: Describe Data Using the Median
source: Reveal Math Grade 6 — Editable Lesson Presentation (licensed classroom use)

slides.caption: Notice & Wonder — what do you notice about the teaching-experience data?
How can you organize the values to find the middle?
The values in order — what does it mean to be in the middle?
Math is Applying — find the median another way.
Collaborate & Connect — the same data on a dot plot.
Worked summary — the median describes the data set.
More teachers join the data — how does the median change?
An even number of values — the median is halfway between the middle two.
Learning targets — can you do these now?
